channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Seven killed in chain collision involving car, bike, canter on Bengaluru national highway
item.description: Seven people were killed in a chain collision on the Hoskote-Dabaspete National Highway in Bengaluru Rural district early Friday. The accident involved an XUV car, a motorcycle, and a canter truck. Preliminary reports suggest the car, traveling from Kolar to Devanahalli, first hit the bike and then collided with the truck.

item.title: New CPI series to make poverty estimates, policy responses more accurate: CEA Nageswaran
item.description: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran highlighted that the revised CPI captures a shift from food to services like health, education, mobility, and connectivity, reflecting income growth and productivity gains.

item.title: US Senate showdown over crypto rules, SEC power
item.description: A heated US Senate debate focused on the future of crypto regulation and the SEC's authority. SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins defended a shift from "regulation by enforcement" toward clearer statutory rules, aiming to clarify roles between the SEC and CFTC for digital assets.

item.title: Tech giant Apple to open its 6th store in India on Feb 26
item.description: Apple is set to open its sixth store in India, Apple Borivali, on February 26 at 1 pm, marking its second store in Mumbai.

item.title: Delhi's air quality improves to 'moderate' as AQI drops to 183
item.description: Delhi's air quality improved to a 'moderate' level on Friday, with the AQI dropping to 183, after registering 'poor' levels of 209 on Thursday and 294 on Wednesday.

item.title: Ram Charan and Upasana reveal names of their twins; here's what they mean
item.description: Ram Charan and his wife Upasana held the traditional Naamkaran (naming ceremony) with a pooja, in the presence of their families. They have named their twins Shivram and Anveera Devi.

item.title: 'Look forward to working with you': PM Modi congratulates Tarique Rahman on BNP's win in Bangladesh elections
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Tarique Rahman on leading the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) to a decisive victory in Bangladesh's 13th parliamentary elections. Modi expressed India's continued support for a democratic, inclusive Bangladesh and looked forward to working with Rahman to strengthen bilateral relations.

item.title: Funky movie review: Audience call it compilation of comedy scenes without organic flow
item.description: Director Anudeep KV's Telugu movie Funky starring Vishwak Sen, VK Naresh and Kayadu Lohar has received mixed reviews and average ratings from the audience around the world.

item.title: O'Romeo: CBFC keeps Shahid Kapoor, Triptii Dimri's intimate kissing scenes, cuss words; cuts women getting slapped
item.description: Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri's O'Romeo, directed by Vishal Bhardwaj, will drop in theatres on Friday, February 13, 2026. The film has been granted an A (Adults Only) certificate by the Central Board of Film Certification.

item.title: No bail, still in jail: Court slams Rajpal Yadav over Rs 9 crore cheque bounce case; is he bankrupt?
item.description: The Delhi High Court criticised Rajpal Yadav in the cheque-bounce case, saying he went to prison for failing to honour his repayment commitment. Amid the crisis, several members of the film fraternity, including Salman Khan, Ajay Devgn, David Dhawan and Sonu Sood, extended financial support.
